patronOf.en-US: The priest's last prayer at the altar, before the blessing
patronOf.pt-BR: A última oração do sacerdote no altar, antes da bênção

prayerExcerpt.en-US: May the performance of my homage be pleasing to Thee, O holy Trinity.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Santíssima Trindade, seja-Vos agradável a homenagem da minha escravidão.

meta.basis: After Ite, missa est the priest, 'ante medium Altaris stans junctis manibus super eo, et capite inclinato, dicit secreto: Placeat tibi, sancta Trinitas', then kisses the altar and blesses the people (Ritus servandus XII.1); the Missal was closed after the Postcommunion (XI.1) and the chalice stands veiled at the middle (X.5). In the old rite the dismissal comes before this prayer and the blessing.
